summary: Static source/test verification of Windows WiX installer fixes (Bug 1: shortcut Target; Bug 2: LaunchFirstRun via FileRef). Ran `python -m pytest windows/tests` -> 150 passed, 0 failed in 0.58s. Confirmed both fixes present in windows/installer/RoofSpan.wxs and file is well-formed XML. No app runtime testing performed (Windows-native codebase; not applicable in Linux container).
critical_code_review_comments: Bug 1 fix verified — RoofSpan.wxs lines 106-115: ScStartMenuOffice (Directory="StartMenuRoofSpan") and ScDesktopOffice (Directory="DesktopFolder") both include Target="[ToolsDir]RoofSpanOffice.exe", Name="RoofSpan Office", WorkingDirectory="ToolsDir". Neither targets the tools directory only (no Target="[ToolsDir]").

Bug 2 fix verified — RoofSpan.wxs line 217: CustomAction Id="LaunchFirstRun" FileRef="OfficeLauncherExe" ExeCommand="" Execute="deferred" Impersonate="yes" Return="asyncNoWait". grep confirms no 'http://127.0.0.1:8001' and no 'cmd.exe /c start' anywhere in the .wxs file. The only 'cmd.exe' occurrence is on line 216 inside an XML comment explicitly documenting what LaunchFirstRun is NOT.
XML well-formedness verified via xml.etree.ElementTree parse of windows/installer/RoofSpan.wxs — no parse errors.

All 150 pre-existing WebView2-shell static tests still pass unchanged (project config, local-UI host, readiness deadline, error separation, external navigation, per-user WebView2 data dir hardening, single-instance, shell build pipeline, WebView2 runtime HKLM+HKCU detection, python-launcher-removal).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Windows WiX/.NET codebase — static verification only. Command: `python -m pytest /app/windows/tests`. All 150 tests pass. Both installer bug fixes (shortcut Target + LaunchFirstRun FileRef) confirmed present.
rca of the issue: Bug 1 RCA: The two <Shortcut> child elements under <Component Id="App_Launcher"> had no explicit Target attribute, so their resolved TargetPath fell back to the containing ToolsDir directory — users got shortcuts that opened the tools folder in Explorer instead of launching RoofSpanOffice.exe. Fix: explicitly set Target="[ToolsDir]RoofSpanOffice.exe" on both shortcuts. Bug 2 RCA: LaunchFirstRun previously ran `cmd.exe /c start http://127.0.0.1:8001/`, opening the local backend URL in the user's default browser rather than the installed WebView2 desktop shell — bypassing single-instance, WebView2 hardening, and per-user data-dir. Fix: use FileRef="OfficeLauncherExe" with empty ExeCommand so MSI directly launches the installed RoofSpanOffice.exe in the deferred/impersonated phase.
